purpose: Test CRMLite through accessibility alone before proposing framework changes.
failures: A named action reports success without changing the observable tree.
Native accessibility cannot navigate, edit a form, choose an option, validate and submit.
A modal leaves background actions enabled or allows them to change the app.
A control exposes expanded state but cannot execute Expand or Collapse.
A retained reference to a removed control can act on a later frame.
A new record is not observable after returning to the list and searching.
Controls outside a scroll viewport cannot be discovered or revealed semantically.
An external AX client cannot discover the owned hidden app even when in-process provider calls work.
constraints: No direct model dispatch for navigation or editing
